thread:
emma (support): Flagging a high-sev from Nexera — they're seeing repeated 5xx/504 timeouts on hosted inference since ~13:02 UTC. Sample: `trace=tr_9a8b7c` and curl repro attached. gateway logs show request_queue_depth ~1200. Need quick triage :rotating_light:

raj (oncall): Acknowledged. Assigning oncall. Tenant id? model? any recent config changes or concurrency ramp?

emma (support): tenant_id: tn_98765, model: rdm/gpt-small-8k, config: continuous_batching=true, max_queue_depth=1024 (default). Customer ramped concurrency from 50 -> 200 in past hour.

amy (infra): Observing continuous-batcher backlog growth on pool-gpu-12: `continuous_batch_backlog=1347`. dequeue rate appears stalled, p95 latency x3. Possible KV cache spin-up on cold path delaying dequeues. snippet from gateway: 
```
2026-03-17T13:03:21Z gateway ERROR 504 "dequeue timeout"
gateway.request_queue_depth=1347
batcher.backlog_ms=12000
```

sven (infra): Also seeing lots of client retries. 429s earlier turned into retry storms (clients backoff too short -> 500s). That amplifies queue pressure. We should apply per-tenant ingress rate limiting immediately.

dev-bot: ALERT: tenant_queue_depth_exceeded tn_98765 depth=1347 threshold=1024

raj (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce continuous_batching window for this tenant 2) enable emergency per-tenant ingress throttle 3) fallback to smaller model variant for the tenant if available 4) ask customer to reduce concurrency. Who can flip the throttle now?

maria (support_engineer): I'm on it. Messaging Nexera to pause the ramp and drop concurrency to 20. They've ack'd and paused for now.

amy (infra): Patching ingress throttle for tenant: `kubectl apply -f /ops/ingress/throttles/tn-98765-emergency.yaml` -> sets burst=100 rate=5rps. Also lowering continuous_batch window for tenant to reduce queue accumulation.

sven (infra): Increasing batcher dequeuers 4->8 on pool-gpu-12 and rolling restart of batcher pods to clear stuck tasks.

emma (support): Customer reports timeouts decreasing after ~30s post-mitigation. Still watching.

raj (oncall): If queue depth remains >800 for 5 minutes we escalate to fail-fast 503 for new incoming requests for that tenant to protect cluster tail latencies.

maria (support_engineer): FYI customer said they saw a "quota exceeded" earlier at 12:58 and their client retried aggressively. They rotated tokens and fixed the auth issue. Not a billing block, but it triggered retry amplification.

amy (infra): Post-mitigation telemetry: `gateway.request_queue_depth=120`, `continuous_batch_backlog=90`, p95 latency trending down. We'll keep monitoring for 15m.

sven (infra): Action items: (1) tighten per-tenant default queue limits and faster automated throttles (2) add guidance for client backoff and jitter in the docs (3) implement automated fail-fast when per-tenant queue depth > 2000.

emma (support): Adding this to the customer RCA timeline and will follow up with Nexera + CSM. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
